FRAMEWORK · qeva:1:real-number@1

Real number

Real numbers complete the rationals so convergent measurement processes need not leave gaps.

editorialanalysis · number-theory
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Real numbers complete the rationals so convergent measurement processes need not leave gaps.

EXACT

The compact statement

Up to unique order-preserving field isomorphism, ℝ is a complete ordered field; completeness may be stated by least upper bounds or equivalent principles.

Example

√2 is real but not rational.

Boundary / caveat

Construction by Dedekind cuts or Cauchy sequences depends on a prior foundation.

Assumptions

  • The declared complete ordered field context is fixed.
